Preparing

Reviewer platform

A separate platform from the banker's: bankers never see this side, and nothing reaches it before they submit. Each submission arrives with its pre-review, the banker's answers and the brief; the candidates the pre-review did not assert are yours to verify, and your verdicts calibrate the next pre-reviews.

Learning

Every verdict becomes a precedent for the next pre-reviews; repeated rejections are distilled into calibration rules; rules the desk keeps rejecting are demoted. The state exports as JSON so it outlives this page.
